scope: Real source interface in headless Chromium with isolated in-memory native task transport; no live network writes
checks: Accepted group opens readable source, before/after and human testing history in the existing dialog
Verification requires a build and explicit human confirmation; private proof clears the gate without completing the task or enabling Auto-Sync
Requesting reversal records history and reopens testing while current content and original result remain unchanged
Full history/reference export preserves original and inverse values and carries no execution authorization
History and testing form stays above its action footer at 620px height
NPCDex and task manager use the existing flashing-amber light and approved status-menu order
Reduced-motion preference keeps both existing light lenses static
